Name: Siren Head Mod
Author: v4vincenzo
Description:
Anyone a fan of Siren Head here? (The character Siren Head was created by Trevor Henderson) Now you can transform your Stardew Valley farmer into Siren Head! The male version has red lights whilst the female version has teal lights for version 1, the male version has green lights whilst the female version has yellow lights in version 2. Keep in mind: This is my first mod and I still would like to continue updating and improving it, I hope you like it! Also this mod is pretty cursed. To install the mod just put the CP Siren Head folder into the mods folder. common > Stardew Valley > Contents > MacOS/Windows > Mods

[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]: Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to work. Requires Custom Music if you want to download the sound effect.

[b]WARNING[/b]: Removes sprites of hats, clothes, accessorries, trousers. This mod will only display the Siren Head character.

Also make sure to give me feedback if there's anythig you would like me to improve on. Enjoy! ?
